note: Practitioner reference set, NON-authoritative. Collected 2026-10-03. IMPORTANT ACCESS LIMITATION: in this environment WebFetch was blocked by the egress proxy for every source domain tried (elliottwave-forecast.com, elliottwave.com, fxstreet.com, fxempire.com, investing.com, cmtassociation.org, liquidityfinder.com, elliottwaveplus.com, wavetraders.com; web.archive.org also refused). All entries were therefore extracted from WebSearch result summaries of the specific article (one targeted title search per article), not from reading the full page; every entry is marked 'partly-explicit'. Wave labels and prices are recorded as the summaries attributed them to that page; some summaries contained degree-label inconsistencies (notably the XAUUSD 2025-10-01 entry), flagged in the claim text. Dates: taken from the FXStreet URL timestamp (YYYYMMDDhhmm), dated URL paths (fourdimensiontrading, pureelliottwave, elliottwavestockmarket, wavetraders), or X/Twitter post IDs (snowflake-decoded; used for 3 entries). EWF entries are futures/ETF-based (ES, NQ, YM, RTY, NKD, CL, QQQ, IWM) - price levels differ from cash indices. Authors: 'Alchemy Markets (series attribution)' = FXStreet 'DJI Elliott Wave forecast' series whose sibling titles appear on alchemymarkets.com, individual byline only verified for the 2026-02-25 piece. FXStreet pieces with author unknown left null. Dr. Arnout ter Schure pieces are mirrored on FXEmpire/Investing.com; the dated FXStreet mirror is used where available. PR001 (EWI) is a forecast dated 2024-05-31 known only via a retrospective EWI article of 2024-08-07 (selection bias: vendors publicize hits). Conflict groups: SPX-2025-12-mid, SPX-2026-06-early, SPX-2026-09, DJIA-2026-05, RUT-2026-Q3, BTC-2026-09-02. Note: EWF short-term counts change frequently, so same-vendor sequential updates are not conflicts. Tried and skipped: Frost & Prechter EWP (1978) Dow 2860 Cycle-V forecast and EWT May/Nov 1989 Nikkei calls (only year/month known, no exact date); Elliott Wave International pages (blocked + mostly retrospective); EWM Interactive weekly SPX/BTC posts (dated in URL but wave counts behind 'Pro Weekly' paywall); ElliottWaveTrader EEM 2024-05-11 (no explicit labels in accessible text); Mark Rivest EEM TradingView idea (2018, date unclear); Investing.com/FXEmpire ID-only URLs without a dated mirror (e.g. 'Primary-V ... higher targets', 'Gold Elliott Wave: Taking a Breather', 'Deep Dive into Bitcoin' (no labels)); Lara Iriarte Russell 2000 2020-07-24 (target figure looked inconsistent with index level); TradingLounge N225/RUT items whose date-to-content mapping was ambiguous; financialcontent 'MarketMinute' EWI piece (aggregator, likely auto-generated); CMT Association ChartAdvisor (blocked, undated in results). Coverage is thin for EEM (1 entry) and pre-2024 data; heavy concentration in 2025-2026 and on two sources (ElliottWave-Forecast and ter Schure). Recommended: re-verify each entry against the full page when network access allows before using as benchmark labels.
